name: Trial of One
desc:
The Trial of One is a dungeon designed to boost experienced players progress easily through early-game progression stat wise, The Trial consists of 9 respective challenges that contains 2 parry checks and 7 monsters (with a simultaneous parry check on the last challenge).

The entrance is located under [Outpost Antumbra](location:outpost_antumbra) in [Minityrsa](location:minityrsa) where at the rear right corner is an open latch leading down to a short hallway which at the end is a slightly opened gate with a fully white glowing entrance. The gate will only allow players who are Power 1 to enter. Otherwise the gate would stun and knock the player back if they exceed the required Power. **You are only able to attempt the Trial once per life** (you cannot re-enter the trial if you have completed the first parry check).

After the completion of each challenge you gain some experience, but you can only train once (after defeating the Megalodaunt, 1 attribute point). Being a very difficult trial for many, its intended for highly skilled and experienced players to get new builds up relatively quickly.
additional_info:
-   Sworn Angels use _Crazy Slots's_ Soulwrought Spears, which differentiate them from Hollow Angels.
-   You can go through the Light gate behind you to return to Minityrsa.
-   If you go into the Trial of One, leave the game, then rejoin, you will be spawned back at the entrance of the challenge at Minityrsa, regardless of your progress in it.
-   Entering the trial with full points from not investing in the character creation menu will force you to waste them when receiving the 1 full point from killing a Sharko, until you reach 6 full points.
-   Deepbounds that somehow make it out of The Depths at Power 1 are not able to enter the Trial of One.
-   You can have enchanted weapons during the Trial via passing down or the Bank. (If you can't beat the Trial, enchanting a starter weapon Providence's Thorns Enchantment may help, as the Trial of One is centered around parrying.)
-   For a short duration, after the addition of the Mudskipper Brute, the Megalodaunt trial was replaced with a Mudskipper Brute. However, this was subsequently changed in the next update and they re-added the Megalodaunt.
-   The architecture of the Trial of One entrance is strangely similar to the [Voidheart](location:voidheart), the orb above the 3 light gates may be a resized model of the [Voidmother](entity:the_voidmother).
    -   Unknown if this means the [Voice of Solitude](entity:voices_of_the_depths) participated in the creation (somehow) or just an oversight by the developers.
-   When you get danger bug from "fearsome enemy" it shows that you are in danger by ".hostage\_nomad9".
    -   Having Providence's Thorns lets you "kill" them and stop the orb attacks.
